mentions.name: Gigspool
mentions.description: A platform where talented people list the services and skills they are experienced in, and clients book paid sessions with them directly through the platform. Once a session is booked, both parties meet online to discuss, collaborate, or get advice based on the expert's expertise.
mentions.audience: Talented people listing the services and skills they are experienced in, and clients looking to book paid sessions with them
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on https://gigspool.com

- Building a platform where talented people can list the services and skills they're experienced in. Clients can book paid sessions with them directly through the platform, and once a session is booked, they both meet online to discuss, collaborate, or get advice based on expertise.
